mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with hydroxychloroquine may increase serotonergic activity and risk of serotonin syndrome; additionally, both drugs can prolong QT interval and cause cardiac conduction abnormalities.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if combination necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms and perform baseline/periodic ECG monitoring for QT prolongation.
